public_tournament_form::B2 Credentials:
const $in = $input.first().json;
return $input.all().map(i => ({ json: { ...i.json, basicAuth: 'Basic ' + Buffer.from(`${$env.B2_KEY_ID}:${$env.B2_APPLICATION_KEY}`).toString('base64') }, binary: i.binary }));
public_tournament_register::Files:
const r = $('Check Request').first();
return (r.json.files || []).map(f => ({ json: f, binary: { file: r.binary[f.field] } }));
